fact: 1906年2月8日，纳塔尔殖民地（Natal）祖鲁人反抗在Mpanza爆发：Hunt与Armstrong两名警察被杀，成为1906—08年祖鲁叛乱的开端；Stuart记载起事者是“提前起事”的基督徒祖鲁人。

sources.title: J. Stuart, A History of the Zulu Rebellion, 1906（MacMillan, 1913；Project Gutenberg eBook #68255）
sources.quote: When, prior to the first outbreak (February 8th), the Governor ascertained that H.M.S. Terpsichore would arrive at Durban on the 21st February... Subsequent to the arrest of the Christian Natives who had murdered Hunt and Armstrong, and to whom belongs the unenviable distinction of having started the Rebellion, and started it prematurely, a general court-martial was appointed to try them.

fact: 镇压反应迅速：1906年2月9日纳塔尔宣布戒严（martial law），次日（2月10日）帝国政府提出派遣一个团进驻彼得里茨堡，殖民地政府接受但表示不预期该部队参加实战；同期殖民地防务因财政紧缩出现缺员。

sources.title: J. Stuart, A History of the Zulu Rebellion, 1906（Project Gutenberg eBook #68255）
sources.quote: It was, therefore, with something of avidity that the offer of the Imperial Government of 10th February (the day following the proclamation of martial law), that a regiment should proceed to Pietermaritzburg, was accepted by Natal. In accepting, however, the Government said it did not anticipate that the troops would be required for active service.

fact: 1906年前后纳塔尔对非洲成年男性的现金税负结构：未婚男子每人每年1英镑人头税（poll tax），已婚男子缴纳14先令房屋税（hut tax）；邻近的德兰士瓦对每名非洲成年男子每年征2英镑，奥兰治自由邦征1英镑人头税。Stuart认为该负担“cannot be regarded as unduly burdensome”，但年轻男子正是人头税的主要承担者。

sources.title: J. Stuart, A History of the Zulu Rebellion, 1906（Project Gutenberg eBook #68255）
sources.quote: the poll tax of £1 per head on the unmarried man, and the hut tax of 14s. on the married man, cannot be regarded as unduly burdensome, especially when compared with the taxes imposed in the adjoining Colonies, Transvaal and Orange Free State. In the former, £2 was payable yearly by every adult male Native... in the latter, a poll tax of £1 was payable by all Natives... The poll tax was imposed on all sections, Europeans, Asiatics and Natives, but, in respect of the last, those already liable for hut tax were specially excepted. It accordingly fell on the young men.

fact: 司法镇压以军事法庭为主：1906年3月12—19日在里士满（Richmond）召开将官级军事法庭，起诉24名叛乱者；此前3月3—12日斯图尔茨敦（Stuartstown）一带同时有最多三个军法庭运作，被捕者经即决军法审判后“sentenced to be shot... The sentence was carried out forthwith”；里士满审判后另有绞刑处决记录于同一文献体系。

sources.title: J. Stuart, A History of the Zulu Rebellion, 1906（Project Gutenberg eBook #68255）
sources.quote: The venue was Richmond. The trial began on the 12th, and ended on the 19th, March. Twenty-four rebels were arraigned by the prosecutor, Captain J. Fraser, N.R.R... During such time as the troops were at Stuartstown, a number of courts-martial were held (beginning on the 3rd and ending on the 12th). As many as three sat at one time... They were tried on the 13th by a drumhead court-martial... were sentenced to be shot. The sentence was carried out forthwith on a peak overlooking Enon forest.

fact: 纳塔尔法律体系中非洲人取得选举权的门槛极高：在殖民地居住满12年、具备财产资格、并被豁免原住民法（Native law）运作满7年的男性原住民，方可在具备财产资格的选区登记为合格选民；Stuart记载实践中几乎无人利用该法。

sources.title: J. Stuart, A History of the Zulu Rebellion, 1906（Project Gutenberg eBook #68255）
sources.quote: the passing of the law under which a male Native, who has been resident in the Colony for a period of twelve years, who has the necessary property qualification, and has been exempted from the operation of Native law for a period of seven years, is entitled to be registered as a qualified elector in the district in which he possesses property qualification. In practice, but little advantage had been taken of this law.

fact: 纳塔尔非洲劳动力长期向德兰士瓦金矿迁移：Barberton与约翰内斯堡金矿以更高工资吸引劳工，年复一年有数千人北上；金矿中心存在专门替工人接收并汇回各自家庭 earnings 的汇款渠道，说明跨境劳工汇款已是成熟生意。

sources.title: J. Stuart, A History of the Zulu Rebellion, 1906（Project Gutenberg eBook #68255）
sources.quote: With the discovery of the Barberton and Johannesburg gold-fields, considerable inducements were offered in the higher wages there obtainable. It, therefore, followed that many accustomed up till then to find employment in Natal, went off to the new centres of industry... [at Johannesburg, youths of Natal were under agents] whose principal duty was to receive and remit to their respective homes the earnings of the workers.

fact: 纳塔尔在1902—1906年经历严重财政萧条并压缩军费：民兵兵力从1902年1,864人增至1904年3,449人（临时上限3,500），1906年反而降至2,854人，比和平时期编制上限短少1,146人；新任指挥官Bru-de-Wold（1905年10月就任）被指令将现役民兵裁减至2,500人。

sources.title: J. Stuart, A History of the Zulu Rebellion, 1906（Project Gutenberg eBook #68255）
sources.quote: the strength rose from 1,864 officers and men in 1902 to 3,449 in 1904... it decreased in 1906 to 2,854. Consequently, there was a shortfall of no less than 1,146 men on a maximum authorized peace establishment at the outbreak of the Rebellion... "Assuming office in October, 1905, during a period of great financial depression, I was confronted with the task of immediately reducing expenditure... I was instructed to reduce the Active Militia to 2,500 of all ranks."

fact: 祖鲁兰注册枪支存量低劣：1897年有5,105支登记枪，1904年仅增至5,126支，其中约90%为旧式滑膛Tower musket等过时类型；另有一定数量未登记枪支与弹药在流通。

sources.title: J. Stuart, A History of the Zulu Rebellion, 1906（Project Gutenberg eBook #68255）
sources.quote: In Zululand, there were as many as 5,105 in 1897; by 1904, they had not increased beyond 5,126--all of them registered. Of the latter, about 90 per cent. were of the old Tower musket, smooth-bore, and other obsolete types. Apart from legally held guns, Dinuzulu was in possession of a number which he had failed to register.
